# August seed envelopes revisited

The beans saved beside the wall survived another dry spell but yielded little. The vigorous row did well after the wet June. My drought-resistance story was too tidy. [[Garden notebook]] still helped because the envelopes retained their origins. A record can be useful even when the hypothesis it preserves turns out to be weak.
